artifact_scope: Complete existing evidence and both report snapshots, extracted from an immutable Git commit. No workload is rerun and no missing historical raw output is reconstructed.
long_term_availability: The complete normalized archive remains in Git history after the workflow artifact expires. Its manifest retains original raw hashes and explicitly records unavailable historical raw fuzz logs.
download_command: gh run download <archive-run-id> --repo sskycn/netbaiot --name strict-review-20261013-85e4a2b --dir target/evidence/strict-review-20261013

publication_failure.observed_failure: Existing evidence budget rejects raw CSV/log files in docs/performance; release preflight and dependency audit passed.
publication_failure.repair: Retain reviewed reports and this compact archive reference in the active documentation tree. Publish the unchanged full archive under target/evidence as an Actions artifact and preserve it in Git history. Evidence policy and allowlist remain unchanged.
